nodes.description: Mapping address=>uint256 holding token balances; mutated in _tokenTransfer and read in balanceOf/_transfer.
Total supply 2,000,000,000 * 10**8 assigned at construction.
Transfer tax percentage (8 by default), reduced by decreaseTax and consumed by _tokenTransfer.
Payable address receiving ETH fees via sendETHToFee.
Per-transaction cap (~1% of supply), enforced in _transfer and raised by increaseBuyLimit.
Maximum wallet holding (~2% of supply), enforced in _transfer and raised by increaseMaxWallet.
Uniswap V2 router instance used for swaps, pair creation and liquidity.
Uniswap pair address set by createUniswapPair and compared against in _transfer.
Reentrancy guard flag toggled by the lockTheSwap modifier and checked in _transfer.
Flag enabling contract-token swaps; set true in addLiquidity.
Ownable owner address; gate for the onlyOwner modifier on privileged functions.
Mapping of addresses exempted from tax and limits.
Blacklist mapping checked in _transfer; written by blockBots/unblockBot.
Nested allowance mapping read/written by _approve and transferFrom.
Private core transfer routine performing limit checks, blacklist checks, optional swap-to-ETH external calls, then _tokenTransfer.
Private lockTheSwap function approving the router and swapping tokens for ETH via the Uniswap router.
Private function forwarding ETH to _taxWallet via transfer.
Owner-only function approving router, creating the pair, and approving the pair for max uint.
Owner-only function adding ETH liquidity, then enabling swap and trading.
Private accounting routine splitting tax, updating balances and emitting Transfer.
Public ERC20 transfer delegating to _transfer with _msgSender().
Public ERC20 transferFrom delegating to _transfer and then _approve.
Public ERC20 approve delegating to _approve.
Private allowance writer used by approve, transferFrom, swap and pair creation.
Owner-only tax reduction with require(newTaxRate<_taxFee).
Owner-only max transaction amount increase.
Owner-only max wallet amount increase.
Owner-only loop adding addresses to the bots blacklist.
Owner-only function removing an address from the blacklist.
Unrestricted public function draining the contract ETH balance to _taxWallet.
Payable receive hook accepting plain ETH transfers.
CULTFLOKI constructor setting tax wallet from _msgSender(), tax rate, router, supply and limits.
msg.sender returned by _msgSender(); caller-controlled input used as transfer origin and constructor tax wallet.
block.timestamp used as the swap deadline and liquidity deadline.
External call _uniswap.swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens executed before balance updates.
External value transfer _taxWallet.transfer(amount) to an owner-controlled recipient.
External payable call _uniswap.addLiquidityETH{value: address(this).balance}.
External call to the factory createPair returning an untrusted pair address.
External call IERC20(_pair).approve(address(_uniswap), type(uint).max) on an untrusted pair.

edges.reason: transfer delegates to _transfer.
transferFrom delegates to _transfer.
transferFrom calls _approve to decrease allowance.
approve calls _approve.
_transfer finalizes accounting via _tokenTransfer.
_transfer invokes swapTokensForEth (external router call) before balances are updated.
_transfer invokes sendETHToFee which pushes ETH to an external address.
sendFee forwards the whole contract balance to sendETHToFee.
swapTokensForEth approves the router before swapping.
createUniswapPair approves the router for the total supply.
swapTokensForEth performs the external router swap call.
sendETHToFee performs the external ETH transfer to the tax wallet.
addLiquidity performs the external addLiquidityETH call.
createUniswapPair calls the factory createPair.
createUniswapPair approves the newly created pair.
Uniswap router swap transfers ETH to the contract and can re-enter _transfer/receive before state finalization.
ETH transfer to the tax wallet executes recipient fallback while _transfer accounting is still incomplete.
Caller-controlled _msgSender() becomes the 'from' of _transfer, directing the reentrant external-call path.
transfer uses _msgSender() as sender.
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as spender.
approve uses _msgSender() as owner.
Constructor assigns _taxWallet from _msgSender(), granting fee-collection privilege to the deployer.
block.timestamp is used as the swap deadline, making execution time-dependent.
block.timestamp is used as the liquidity deadline.
_inSwap guard flag is read in _transfer to prevent nested swaps.
_taxWallet receives the ETH pushed by sendETHToFee.
Balance mapping is updated with SafeMath add/sub in _tokenTransfer.
_taxFee drives the tax multiplication in _tokenTransfer.
_uniswap router receives the swap call.
_uniswap router supplies factory, WETH and approvals.
onlyOwner compares _owner to _msgSender() on decreaseTax.
onlyOwner guards increaseBuyLimit.
onlyOwner guards increaseMaxWallet.
onlyOwner guards the blockBots blacklist mutation.
onlyOwner guards unblockBot.
onlyOwner guards createUniswapPair.
onlyOwner guards addLiquidity.
_isExcludedFromFee determines fee and limit bypass in _transfer.
bots blacklist is checked in _transfer.
_maxTxAmount bounds the transfer amount in _transfer.
_maxWallet bounds the recipient balance in _transfer.
_pair is compared against from/to in _transfer.
_swapEnabled gates the automatic swap in _transfer.
balanceOf(address(this)) is read in _transfer to size the swap.
_allowances is written by _approve.
_allowances is read and reduced by transferFrom.
from parameter drives checks and balance debits.
to parameter drives checks and balance credits.
amount parameter is validated against limits.
contractTokenBalance becomes the swap input amount.
contractETHBalance is forwarded to sendETHToFee.
tokenAmount is passed to the router swap.
amount is transferred to the tax wallet.
newTaxRate is written to _taxFee.
amount is written to _maxTxAmount.
amount is written to _maxWallet.
tAmount is the base for tax and net computations.
taxRate multiplies the gross amount.
tTeam arithmetic (mul/div) determines the taxed portion.
tTransferAmount subtraction determines the credited amount.
bots_ array entries are written into the blacklist.
notbot is cleared from the blacklist.

Intermediate tax result used to debit sender and credit the contract.
Intermediate net result credited to the recipient and emitted.
